title: ClayGraph Cycle 2 — Query-Planned Evidence-Bounded Activation
summary: Cycle 2 keeps accepted generation 0 and replaces the prior held G1 candidate with a preferred held G1b candidate. G1b adds an AssemblyPlanner that routes exact/current, historical, associative, multihop and audit queries differently; uses deterministic packet/lexical/exact seeds plus optional vector retrieval; limits graph traversal to relevance-gated qualified edges; preserves stale/refuted material for audit intent; and applies soft evidence-family anti-echo rather than hard deletion. A 53-item/20-query designed proxy improved overall recall and stale/evidence-family metrics, while held-out recall did not improve and precision was slightly lower. Under 200 erroneous-qualified-edge stress runs G1b was more robust. Promotion remains blocked pending actual-corpus and target-model tests.
